resources.string: Audex Revival is Audible Access. It plays short sounds for events such as clicking, touching, swiping, opening and closing windows and menus, scrolling, performing gestures and long pressing. A different sound is associated with each event.
Audex Revival is Audible Access. It plays short sounds for events such as clicking, touching, swiping, opening and closing windows and menus, scrolling, performing gestures and long pressing.
Open Audex settings to choose a sound scheme, change volumes, and turn individual events on or off. Smart labeling gives spoken labels to controls that do not have one.

Audex Revival plays short sounds for what happens on screen: clicks, focus changes, touches, scrolling, gestures, window changes, charger events, and the screen turning on or off.

Use Sound scheme to switch between the four original schemes: Innovex, Voiceover, Talkback and Classic Talkback. Smart labeling adds spoken labels to controls that do not have one.

The theme store lists community sound themes hosted on GitHub. Installing a theme downloads its audio and adds it to the sound-scheme list. Nothing is sent from your device; the app only reads the public store index and the package you choose.

When Audex Revival is handling touch exploration, swipe left then right with two fingers to hear the time, and swipe right then left to hear the battery level.

This revival keeps the original sounds. It removes the abandoned Firebase news service, the anti-piracy code, the privileged auto-enable hack and the dead web links.

Original Audex by Akash Kakkar (Akash Delight Computings), 2017. Thank you for making Android more audible.

Community sound themes from GitHub. Installing a theme downloads its audio into this app. Themes are audio-only packages, checked against the store checksum before they are used. Nothing about you is sent anywhere.
